summary: Iteration 33 — validated ShopPHP REST write-back credential/push flow. Backend 11/11 pytest cases pass: (1) GET /api/integrations/ecommerce → shopphp rest_configured=false and rest_password_enc NOT exposed; (2) POST /api/orders/{shopphp_id}/push-shopphp with no creds → 400 detail contains 'REST API kullanıcı bilgileri girilmemiş'; (3) POST push-shopphp on a Trendyol order → 400 with 'ShopPHP'; (4) POST rest-test with no creds → 400; (5) PUT rest-credentials {qa@test.com/x/auto_push:false} → rest_configured=true, auto_push=false; (6) GET list after → rest_configured=true, rest_auto_push=false, still no rest_password_enc exposed; (7) POST rest-test with invalid creds → 502 (not 500); (8) POST push-shopphp with invalid creds → 502 and order.shopphp_push.ok=false with error text; (9) PUT /api/orders/{id}/status regression → 200 (hook silent); (10) POST sync-now?days=30 → success. Cleanup mandatory Mongo unset verified via API (rest_configured back to false). Frontend UI verified live at /ecommerce ShopPHP 'Ayarlar' modal — shopphp-rest-section + email/password/auto/save/test testids all present; test button correctly disabled without password and enabled after typing; Save shows toast 'REST bilgileri kaydedildi.' and shopphp-rest-ok appears; Test click yields 502 (no crash). /orders shows 3 ShopPHP push links (shopphp-push-631364089, shopphp-push-430959168, shopphp-push-425878531) with text 'Mağazaya Bildir'; Trendyol rows have no such link (visual confirmation). Push click yields 502 error (no crash).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3577 rest-test endpoint hits '/orders/date/YYYY-MM-DD_YYYY-MM-DD' via HTTP Basic against the real store; on invalid creds ShopPHPClient likely surfaces this as HTTPException with 502-ish detail from provider — verified 502 returned (not 500), OK. Consider unifying to a lightweight ping endpoint if the store REST offers one, to avoid tying connectivity test to orders payload availability.

In _push_order_to_shopphp (server.py:3549) only HTTPException is caught; if ShopPHPClient.update_order raises a bare Exception (network/DNS/parse), it will propagate as 500. Add generic 'except Exception as e' to log ok=False with str(e) so silent auto-hooks (approve/status/invoice/cargo) don't leak 500s.

server.py:3554 orders.update_one uses order['_id'] direct write path — fine, but the frontend uses ord.id in /orders payload; consistency check: /api/orders serialization must expose shopphp_push field (verified present in list response).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. During test PUT set rest_email='qa@test.com'+rest_password_enc + rest_auto_push=false, then Mongo unset rest_password_enc, reset rest_email='', rest_auto_push=true, cleared orders.shopphp_push and shopphp_push_logs. Post-cleanup verified via API: rest_configured=false, rest_auto_push=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ShopPHP orders in live tenant (order_numbers: 631364089, 430959168, 425878531). Live store REST endpoint returns 502-equivalent for invalid creds — good. Real REST credentials still not provided; success path of update_order was NOT exercised. Order objects in /api/orders responses use 'id' (not '_id'). Login response uses key 'token'. Mongo cleanup command used: db.integration_configs.updateOne({_id:'ecom_shopphp'}, {$unset:{rest_password_enc:1}, $set:{rest_email:'', rest_auto_push:true}}); db.orders.updateMany({channel:'shopphp'}, {$unset:{shopphp_push:1}}); db.shopphp_push_logs.deleteMany({}).
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature validation, no bug. All error paths behave as spec: 400 for missing creds / wrong channel, 502 for upstream failures, credential encryption never leaks in list. Auto-hooks stay silent without creds (approve/status/invoice/cargo call _push_order_to_shopphp which returns None if creds absent).
